column1: # Phase E: name <TAB> SQE SQL <TAB> Databricks SQL ("=" when identical). @S@ is the schema.
# Timestamps compare as epoch microseconds (the Databricks statement API prints milliseconds).

column2: SELECT id, name, amount, CAST(ts AS BIGINT), CAST(ntz AS BIGINT), CAST(d AS STRING), flag, big, dbl, upper(encode(bin, 'hex')) FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic ORDER BY id
column3: SELECT id, name, amount, unix_micros(ts), unix_micros(CAST(ntz AS TIMESTAMP)), CAST(d AS STRING), flag, big, dbl, hex(bin) FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic ORDER BY id

column2: SELECT id FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' ORDER BY id
column3: SELECT id FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' ORDER BY id

column2: SELECT id FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic WHERE ntz < TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY id

column2: SELECT count(*), sum(amount), min(d), max(big) FROM @S@.dbx_run_basic
